title: Banana dimension
description: A minecraft dimension mod themed after bananas
body:
A dimension themed after Bananas.

 

How to get in the dimension

To access the Banana Dimension, build a dirt portal, (a nether portal made of dirt) and light it with a Flint and Banana.

 

How to get bananas and a flint and banana

To get a Banana, place one apple in your crafting table. To get a Flint and Banana, it's pretty self-explanatory. just place a banana and a flint in your crafting table.

 

In the dimension

NOTE: biome generation will be updated in 1.1.

In the dimension, there is banana grass, banana stone, and banana juice. (I know my textures look horrible, but I'll update them.) There are oak trees generating around the dimension, banana juice being water, and banana stone in caves/underground. Currently, you can't do anything with the blocks, but I'll update that soon.

 

Plans for v1.1

I plan to add many things for 1.1. here's a list:

1. update Mod description

2. banana cows

3. banana wood

4. banana leaves

 

I hope you like the mod. If I update the description, I will put the previous one in the images.
